milestones.title: Lemma 2 — Refined finite one-sided coupling
milestones.milestone_description: Finite version of the first estimate in Lemma 2 of Lagdive, Aglave and Damre. Let a finite set carry weights w ≥ 0 with total mass one. Let U,V be real functions with identical weighted laws, expressed as equality of weighted expectations for every real test function. For every real centre m and a ≥ 0, if V − U ≤ a wherever w is nonzero, then E[(U − V)²] ≤ 4a E[|U − m|] + a². No independence or two-sided displacement bound is assumed. The linked theorem already has an ACCEPTED proof and is a dependency of the main theorem's accepted reduction. Source: https://github.com/log-prathm/ptf-average-sensitivity/blob/5e9f26cf74935f08be20f9ac4deb57b291d707d8/paper/main.tex .

milestones.title: Theorem extract_constant — Universal coefficient 3.762
milestones.milestone_description: The exact scalar implication AverageSensitivity.extract_constant in the present fixed-source development: for all positive integers n,d and every real A, the two bounds A ≤ n and A ≤ 8 d b_n + 2 d² imply A ≤ (1881/500) d √n. Here b_n = 2^(−n−1) ∑_{j=0}^n binom(n,j)|2j−n| is the mean absolute deviation of Binomial(n,1/2), as fixed by the referenced definition module. This includes every positive dimension and degree, with no asymptotic qualification. The coefficient extraction is proved in this development; the earlier paper is credited for the dimension-degree estimate. The linked theorem already has an ACCEPTED proof and is a dependency of the main theorem's accepted reduction. Source: https://github.com/Anchen0823/average-sensitivity-lean/blob/a0d88dedd8e56f371e40bf1dfcd533afb51e3d04/AverageSensitivity/ConstantExtraction.lean .
